description: This file defines the SageMaker embedding configuration class, supporting the transformation of requests and responses, model configuration, and environment validation specific to SageMaker's embedding API.

classes.name: SagemakerEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for handling embedding transformations, error handling, and environment validation for SageMaker embedding models.

methods.name: "BaseEmbeddingConfig" get_model_config(cls, model: str)
methods.description: Returns appropriate embedding configuration instance based on the model name.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI-like parameters for the specified model.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict, model: str, drop_params: bool, )
methods.description: Maps and filters OpenAI parameters for the request.

methods.name: BaseLLMException get_error_class( self, error_message: str, status_code: int, headers: Union[dict, Headers] )
methods.description: Returns an error instance corresponding to a given error message and response status.

methods.name: dict transform_embedding_request( self, model: str, input: "AllEmbeddingInputValues", optional_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms input data into a request payload expected by SageMaker models.

methods.name: "EmbeddingResponse" transform_embedding_response( self, model: str, raw_response: Response, model_response: "EmbeddingResponse", logging_obj: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, request_data: dict = {}, optional_params: dict = {}, litellm_params: dict = {}, )
methods.description: Processes the raw response from SageMaker, extracting embeddings and updating the response object.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[Any], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates environment settings for SageMaker embeddings, such as headers.
